name: sovereign_ocr_preprocess_image
title: 5-Step Geometry- & DPI-Aware Visual Preprocessor
description: Run the 5-step visual preprocessing pipeline (adaptive DPI, percentile luminance stretching [p1..p95]->[0..255], interior-crop 90/180/270 orientation detection, two-stage projection-profile deskew [-12..+12 deg], and Lanczos receptive-field resize) on an image or PDF page.

input_path.description: Absolute path to the input image (.png, .jpg, .tiff, .webp) or .pdf file

output_path.description: Optional output path where the preprocessed PNG will be written

page_index.description: 0-based page index when input_path is a PDF
